headline: conditional_response_geometry

manuscript_interpretation.primary_result: Pollinator reorganization produces a non-monotonic response geometry whose sign depends on starting functional position and realized pollinator community, and mixed mean geometry occupies a nontrivial fraction of the declared joint parameter design.
manuscript_interpretation.local_context_role: Local availability / interaction filtering is a strong bidirectional branch allocator; its first sign-change threshold has median support_strength 0.40 in the declared synthetic envelope.
manuscript_interpretation.assurance_role: Autonomous assurance is not a sign-rescue mechanism in the declared model envelope. Even at 4x the existing assurance ceiling/responsiveness, no eligible service-decline lineage crosses the reproduction sign boundary. It should be described only as magnitude attenuation.
manuscript_interpretation.excluded_claim: Do not present assurance as a second strong buffering branch or infer an empirical 0.40 filtering threshold for real islands.

claim_boundary: This closes the synthetic model robustness gate, not empirical causal identification. Design-space frequencies and thresholds are robustness descriptors of the declared model. Empirical island systems still require source-native tests before mechanism admission.
